raw_error_chain.interpretation: Initialization is the first logged failure; CreateSound rejects an uninitialized system. The subsequent GetLength receives the null bank and fails invalid parameter. The resource guard stops before consuming its unwritten length. This evidence does not diagnose corrupted FSB bytes.
